Build your career at SCOR Bucharest, where top Romanian and international talent shape the future of reinsurance business, finance and technology – keeping SCOR at the forefront of innovation worldwide.
As a QA Engineer, you are responsible for helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software by combining hands-on testing, risk-based quality assurance, and test automation. A key part of the role is expanding and maintaining automated test coverage for business-critical functionality, embedding quality controls into delivery pipelines, and helping teams release software with confidence. You will also perform exploratory and targeted manual testing, assess risk, identify defects, and provide independent assessments of quality and risk where human investigation adds value.You will join the Tech & Data department (more than 200 employees across the globe) and will be able to grow and evolve in a global and very dynamic structure providing products, services, and support to all SCOR Group worldwide.   Quality Assurance & TestingYou validate new functionality, bug fixes, and enhancements delivered by engineering teams through structured manual testing and exploratory testing.You assess changes using risk-based testing principles, prioritizing testing effort on the areas with the highest business impact and likelihood of failure.You identify, document, reproduce, and track defects while collaborating closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.You verify fixes, confirm regression impact, and provide clear release sign-off recommendations.You evaluate both expected behaviour and edge cases to ensure software performs reliably in real-world scenarios.Test Automation & EngineeringYou transform manual test scenarios into maintainable automated test suites that improve coverage and reduce repetitive manual effort.You contribute to the development and maintenance of automated testing frameworks and pipelines integrated into our software delivery process.You build and maintain automated end-to-end, integration, and regression tests using modern testing tools and engineering practices.You help improve testing scalability, reliability, and maintainability through continuous improvement of frameworks, tooling, and processes.Collaboration & Quality OwnershipYou partner with developers to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility rather than a final checkpoint.You contribute to discussions on requirements, acceptance criteria, solution design, and testability before development begins.You help engineering teams improve testing practices, quality awareness, and risk identification throughout the SDLC.You communicate quality risks, testing outcomes, and release readiness clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Innovation & Continuous ImprovementYou stay informed about modern quality engineering approaches, including AI-assisted and agentic testing techniques.You contribute ideas that help the organization keep pace with accelerating software delivery while maintaining high quality standards.You help identify opportunities for improved automation, metrics, reporting, and quality processes.What Will Help You SucceedExperience performing structured software testing in Agile delivery environments.Experience designing and executing test cases, test scenarios, regression pipelines, and modern software delivery workflows.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail and edge cases.Ability to balance thoroughness with pragmatism through risk-based
